paragraphs.text: Azoria was a small plane within the Shard of the Twelve Worlds where Tevesh Szat and Freyalise fought after the Summit of the Null Moon .

Not much is known of it, except that the main planet was covered by a large sea with chains of desert islands appearing sporadically. No humans yet existed on the plane. All of the islands were destroyed by Freyalise to cut off Szat's blue mana supplies, leaving only its highest mountain peak above the water. As a result, Freyalise killed off countless inhabitants of the plane. However, her efforts still failed to thwart Tevesh Szat's plans, instead leaving him with a large source of black mana .
